name: Cabezamesada (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of purple, white and light blue, the white charged with the crowned arms of Cabezamesada (a castle on yellow above a cross of Saint James) and the words VILLA DE CABEZAMESADA.
history: Municipal flag of Cabezamesada; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cabezamesada arms — castle on yellow above a cross of Saint James on white
